evidence.note: Abraham fathers לִאיסחָק, and אִיסחָק fathers Jacob.
Abraham names his son יִצְחָק. Sarah uses the same consonants when she says that everyone who hears will laugh.
The phrase “house of Isaac” preserves the Hebrew form יִשְׂחָק alongside the designation Israel.

name: אִיסחָק
summary: Matthew names Isaac between Abraham and Jacob. Genesis connects his Hebrew name יִצְחָק with Sarah’s laughter. The Syriac spelling has ס where the Hebrew variant יִשְׂחָק has שׂ.
